## Abstract
In the universe of artificial intelligence, a giant misunderstanding exists. Many people view Large Language Models, such as GPT-4 or Gemini, as massive knowledge bases. People imagine these models act like superpowered encyclopedias that know every fact in the world. Technically speaking, this assumption is completely incorrect.
